title: Genesis Canada - Genesis EVs to adopt the North American Charging Standard
notes: Canada: from 2025 all new or refreshed Genesis EVs get exclusively a NACS port; Genesis EVs with CCS ports get Tesla Supercharger access via an adapter from Q1 2025. Names the GV60 and Electrified GV70; the G80 is not named. Forward-looking announcement (2023); the fetched host is Genesis Canada's p-www mirror.
